about: A StatefulSet's or DaemonSet's verdict once its pods are asked, as both halves read it: `with_starts` in src/tauri/src/resources/workloads/rollout.rs (the page, the peek, Share, Needs attention and Connections) and `withStarts` in src/ui/lib/workload-status.ts (the list). Neither kind writes a condition that tells a pod still starting from one that never will, so a set short of available pods is coming up only while some pod is still starting and none shows a fault. Each pod arrives as `pod_start` read it in Rust: settled (ready, finished or terminating), starting until an instant, or failing. A start whose instant has passed is the fault. No pod starting means nothing explains the gap: a pod the controller could not create looks exactly like that, so the set stays short. Every state but short passes through.
